title: Zesty Croatian Samphire Skewers
description: A tangy and crispy Croatian dish featuring samphire, sashimi-cut and low in calories, served in a cazuela, evoking nostalgic feelings of the Adriatic coast.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the samphire into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the samphire pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated samphire pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a single layer in a cazuela or a large baking dish.
Bake the samphire skewers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until crispy and tender.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
